_note: The ending montage (src/game/outro.js): plays after the endings where Clementine is brought up out of the Undercroft (endings), then the ending's own card follows. All words here.
title: THE MARIGOLD SILENCE
titleSub: Case closed · Thank you for playing

captions.out: Sable Flat. For the first time in two days, the sky is clear.
captions.apron: That evening, Sable Flat empties out. Everyone is going home.
captions.takeoff: Mail plane NC-11427, bound for home.

E1.speaker: Danny Cole
E1.text: Easy now, miss. Mind your step.

E1.speaker: Clementine Pryce
E1.text: I'd forgotten how big the sky is.

E3.speaker: Danny Cole
E3.text: Every day, miss. Every single day.

E1short.speaker: Danny Cole
E1short.text: Every day, miss. Every single day.

clementine.note: under the open sky, after seven hundred and thirty-three days

farewells.text: The wires are quiet tonight, Inspector. No more ghosts. I reckon I'll sleep. Thank you.
Inspector, darling. I came here for a weekend and I'm leaving with the truth. I never expected to be grateful for that. Thank you.
Two years I flew over that hangar and never once looked down. Thank you for looking, Inspector.

farewells.note: the doctor, ready to tell it all at last
farewells.text: I have been afraid for two years. Tonight I am only tired. Thank you, Inspector. Truly.

farewells.note: Meridian Air, catching the night train
farewells.text: Bravo, Inspector. I have sat through a great many last acts. That was the finest of them.

farewells.note: the secretary, out of a job and glad of it
farewells.text: Not bad, Inspector. Not bad at all. ...Thanks. I mean it.

farewells.note: the mechanic, letting his pigeons go
farewells.text: I'll let the birds out tonight, sir. All of them. Thank you for being kind to her.

cabin.speaker: Danny Cole
cabin.text: Chief? I'll write it all up tonight. Every word of it, in my neatest hand.

cabin.speaker: Hart
cabin.text: Best report the Bureau will ever read, Danny.
